Accessories and support items do not imply standalone pages, campaigns, forms, automations, SEO, selectors, calculators, configurators, export/OEM/partner/multilingual expansion, or extra product pages unless separately approved in writing. Related alignment references: Services Agreement Final Signature Copy; aligned Annexure A Funnel Architecture; aligned Annexure B Commercial Structure & Pricing; Puretronics Wire & Cable Product Master Database. --- # Purpose This hub is the operating layer for the Puretronics Wire & Cable Product Master Database. Use it to orient human users and AI agents before navigating the product database, creating proposals, building funnel architecture, or extracting sales and technical intelligence. # Primary Asset [Puretronics Wire & Cable Product Master Database](/p/c303dd29567d83f9bfc301995427e6e7?pvs=25) # Recommended Navigation Order 1. Start with the signed Services Agreement and aligned Annexure A/B pages when the work involves scope, proposal, funnel, campaign, or commercial interpretation. 2. Start with `01 Sales Snapshot` for a fast product overview. 3. Use `02 Manufacturing Flow` to understand where products sit in the wire and cable manufacturing process. 4. Use `03 Buyer Discovery` for persona-led discovery and sales conversations. 5. Use `04 Product Family Navigator` to compare product families. 6. Use `06 Technical Lookup` for specifications and quotation preparation. 7. Use `10 Source & Spec Governance` before making hard technical claims. # View System
View Primary Use
`00 Admin - All Properties` Full maintenance view for database operators.
`01 Sales Snapshot` Quick commercial overview for sales and proposal work.
`02 Manufacturing Flow` Ordered production-line map from pay-off/unwind through data/reporting.
`03 Buyer Discovery` Persona, problem, question, CTA, and sales-note view.
`04 Product Family Navigator` Portfolio navigation by product family.
`05 Hero Products` Proposal anchors and funnel-first products.
`06 Technical Lookup` Technical comparison and configuration support.
`07 Connected Factory / Industry 4.0` Connected, data, HMI, ERP, reporting, and control products.
`08 Proposal & Funnel Builder` Funnel stage and proposal section planning.
`09 Cross-Sell & Bundles` Bundle logic and complementary product mapping.
`10 Source & Spec Governance` Source coverage, caveats, and quotation-risk review.
# Governance Notes - `Manufacturing Flow Stage` is the ordered line-sequence field. - `Production / Context Tags` is a flexible process/application tag field. - `Solution Theme` is the commercial solution taxonomy. - `Spec Confidence` tells users how safely a specification can be used without further quotation confirmation. - The product master database remains the single product-intelligence source; the signed Services Agreement dated **9 July 2026** governs contracted scope, commercials, exclusions, deliverables, and scope changes. # Related Guide Use the [Master User-Guide - Puretronics Wire & Cable Product Database](/p/88f3dd29567d8348b3f9811b30824878?pvs=25) for exact navigation rules, AI-agent protocol, field interpretation, and maintenance standards.
